title: PPAAS: PVT and Pareto Aware Analog Sizing via Goal-conditioned Reinforcement Learning
problem: Device sizing in analog and mixed-signal circuits requires optimization across diverse performance specifications under process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations.
motivation: Enable generalized RL-based device sizing that efficiently adapts to wide range of design specifications across PVT corners without excessive training overhead.
method: Goal-conditioned RL framework with Pareto-front Dominance Goal Sampling for automatic curriculum learning, integrated with Conservative Hindsight Experience Replay for training stability and Skip-on-Fail simulation strategy for efficiency.
key_novelty: First goal-conditioned RL framework enabling efficient policy training for analog device sizing with strong generalization across PVT corners.
contributions: 1.6x improvement in sample efficiency compared to existing sizing methods
4.1x improvement in simulation efficiency through Skip-on-Fail strategy
Pareto-front-based curriculum learning for stable training
limitations: Evaluated on benchmark circuits; specific to analog device sizing under PVT variations.
primary_theme: Goal-conditioned RL for PVT-robust analog device sizing
